tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background for the website and the platform shell. Body copy on it uses ink-body.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table bodies, modals. In light it matches surface-page, so cards are separated by border-subtle rather than by fill.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: table headers, form sections, page bands behind cards, sidebar rails.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Deep-navy blocks: site footer, hero bands, print letterhead. Text on it must be ink-inverse.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Headings and figures on surface-page, surface-card and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Default body copy on surface-page, surface-card, surface-sunken and brand-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: help text, timestamps, table meta, captions on surface-page, surface-card and surface-sunken. Never for body copy at 13px or below on brand-soft.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: ink-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-inverse: footer link groups, legal lines, letterhead meta. Holds 8.0:1 in light and 6.3:1 in dark. Never use ink-muted on surface-inverse — it measures 2.6:1 and fails.

tokens.name: ink-on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand-primary fill. It flips to near-black in dark because the dark brand fill is light.

tokens.name: brand-primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fills, selected states and active nav. Pair only with ink-on-brand. It is the identity blue one shade deeper in light and lighter in dark so the LABEL stays legible: white on #0069a8 is 5.86:1, while white on the exact brand #007DC5 is 4.43:1 and fails the 4.5:1 floor for button text. The difference is barely visible; the legibility difference is not. For the exact brand blue as colour, use brand-accent.

tokens.name: brand-accent
tokens.usage: The official MIDTRANS identity blue #007DC5, exact and unchanged in both themes. Use it for graphics, rules, chart marks, cover blocks, the focus ring and display type at 24px or larger. White on it measures 4.43:1, so it is not a fill for body-size text: use brand-primary there.

tokens.name: brand-link
tokens.usage: Inline links and quiet button labels on surface-page, surface-card, surface-sunken and brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for highlighted rows, info notices and selected list items. Carries ink-body and brand-link.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative separation only: card outlines, table rules, dividers. It does not carry meaning, so it is exempt from the 3:1 floor.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Meaning-carrying borders: input outlines, checkbox and radio edges, secondary button outlines. Holds 3:1 on surface-page, surface-card and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring, drawn solid at 2px with a 2px offset. This one IS the exact brand #007DC5: a ring needs 3:1, and it holds 4.43:1 on surface-page and 4.05:1 on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Delivered, cleared, paid. Text and icon colour on status-success-soft and on surface-card.

tokens.name: status-success-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and row background behind status-success.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Awaiting documents, customs hold, payment due. Text and icon colour on status-warning-soft and on surface-card.

tokens.name: status-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and row background behind status-warning.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Failed, cancelled, rejected, overdue. Text and icon colour on status-danger-soft and on surface-card; also destructive button labels.

tokens.name: status-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and row background behind status-danger.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: In transit, booked, quotation sent. Text and icon colour on status-info-soft and on surface-card. Deeper than the exact brand blue for the same reason as brand-primary: #007DC5 on status-info-soft measures 3.89:1 at badge size and fails.

tokens.name: status-info-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and row background behind status-info.

tokens.name: status-neutral
tokens.usage: Draft, archived, closed. Text and icon colour on status-neutral-soft and on surface-card.

tokens.name: status-neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and row background behind status-neutral.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First categorical slot: sea freight. Series colours are assigned in this fixed order and NEVER cycled — a fifth category folds into Other. Validated with the palette checker, not chosen by eye: worst adjacent colour-blind separation is ΔE 16.2 in light and 13.6 in dark against a target of 8, every slot clears 3:1 on its surface, and none is a status colour. Re-run that validation before substituting any value. Identity is never carried by colour alone — every series is named in text beside its mark.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second categorical slot: air freight. Validated with the palette checker, not chosen by eye: worst adjacent colour-blind separation is ΔE 16.2 in light and 13.6 in dark against a target of 8, every slot clears 3:1 on its surface, and none is a status colour. Re-run that validation before substituting any value. Identity is never carried by colour alone — every series is named in text beside its mark.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third categorical slot: road freight. Validated with the palette checker, not chosen by eye: worst adjacent colour-blind separation is ΔE 16.2 in light and 13.6 in dark against a target of 8, every slot clears 3:1 on its surface, and none is a status colour. Re-run that validation before substituting any value. Identity is never carried by colour alone — every series is named in text beside its mark.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth categorical slot: multimodal and consolidation. Validated with the palette checker, not chosen by eye: worst adjacent colour-blind separation is ΔE 16.2 in light and 13.6 in dark against a target of 8, every slot clears 3:1 on its surface, and none is a status colour. Re-run that validation before substituting any value. Identity is never carried by colour alone — every series is named in text beside its mark.

families.sans: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, "Liberation Sans", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: One per page: the website hero headline. Set in ink-strong, or brand-accent when it sits alone on surface-page.

styles.name: display-2
styles.usage: Section openers on marketing pages and the top line of a printed quotation.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page title inside the platform: a shipment, a quotation, an account.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section heading within a page, and the title line of a Card.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Sub-section and grouped-field heading inside forms and panels.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under a display-1 or display-2 headline on the website.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default paragraph and control text everywhere. Set in ink-body.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells, dense lists and field help text. Set in ink-body, or ink-muted when secondary.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, table column headers and KeyValue terms. Apply text-transform: uppercase in the component, not in the token.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, footnotes and badge text. Set in ink-muted.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Reference numbers that must be read and copied character by character: booking, AWB, B/L, container and invoice numbers. Add font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Amounts, weights, volumes and dates inside table cells, so columns align on the digit.

styles.name: ar-heading-1
styles.usage: Arabic page title. Leading runs taller than the Latin heading-1 because the shipped Cairo face sets deeper ascenders and descenders.

styles.name: ar-body
styles.sample: نقدم خدمات الشحن البحري والجوي والبري.
styles.usage: Arabic body copy. One step larger than body: Cairo reads smaller than Helvetica at the same size.

styles.name: ar-body-sm
styles.usage: Arabic table cells, help text and captions.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Everything a layout sets — padding, gap, margin — is one of these steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a badge dot and its label; icon-to-text inside a control.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked form controls and between inline buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; padding inside small controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default padding inside a Card and between grouped fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; space above a page heading.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between website page sections.

radius.note: The international enterprise band — the range IBM Carbon, Microsoft Fluent, Atlassian and SAP Fiori all sit in. Soft enough to read as modern software, tight enough that a freight document still reads as a record rather than a consumer card.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, badges, checkboxes and table-embedded controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, panels, modals and result readouts. The default for anything a person clicks or a box that holds content.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero blocks, large media frames, document letterheads and the cover's colour blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots, progress meters and dismissible filter chips only. Never a button: a pill-shaped action reads as consumer marketing, not operations.

shadow.note: Shadow marks elevation, never decoration. A card at rest uses border-subtle alone.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and the site header once the page scrolls.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, popovers and date pickers.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and the mobile navigation sheet.
